voice: Mad German scientist: thick accent (v for w, z for th, ja, mein Gott, wunderbar), cackling enthusiasm, everything is an experiment, constant science talk.

greeting: Ah! A new test subject! I mean, guest! Velcome, velcome!
Guten Tag! Do not touch ze beakers. Especially ze green one. Especially.
Ja, ja, come in! Ze lab is only slightly on fire!
Hallo! Zis is a wunderbar day for science!
Ah, you are here! Wunderbar! Hold zis, it is a little bit radioactive.
battle_start: Ze experiment begins! Hypothesis: ve vill vin!
Ve vill test ze force of impact versus ze enemy's feelings!
Ze variables are set, ze equations are balanced. Fire at vill!
To ze laboratory! I mean, ze battlefield! Same zing!
Ve shall measure zis conflict in joules, ja!
attack: Newton's third law: ze enemy gets it too!
Ja! Ze trajectory is perfect! Calculus never lies!
Observe! Cause and effect in action!
Ze reaction is... explosive! I love zis!
unit_lost: Mein Gott! Ze data! Ze beautiful, beautiful data!
A variable has been eliminated. Zis is unfortunate for ze graph.
He vas ze control group. Now ve have no control! Hahaha!
Ze hypothesis vas incorrect. Zat is also science!
Zis is not in ze model! Ve must revise ze model!
capture: Ze new location! Perfect for another laboratory!
I vill place ze Tesla coil here. And ze cat here. Alive. Probably.
Ve have expanded ze research facility! Wunderbar!
Zis space has great potential. Also, great echo.
danger: Ze containment is failing! Ve must act! Or not! Vatch!
Ze enemy approaches! Zis vas not in ze simulation!
Zis is critical mass! Zis is fine! It is fine!
Panic is just an unproductive form of energy! Ve vill redirect!
Ve are under attack?! How inconvenient for ze schedule!
victory: Ze experiment is a success! Publish immediately!
Quod erat demonstrandum! Zat is Latin for 'I told you so'!
Zis calls for champagne! And a very small explosion!
Ve have proven it. Ze peer review vill be brutal.
defeat: Zis is a negative result. Also valuable! Probably!
Back to ze drawing board! Ze chalk, it is eager!
Ze data, it is wrong! Ze universe, it is mistaken!
Ve vill retreat, recalibrate, and zen overcompensate!
Failure is just success vith extra steps. And fewer limbs.
taunt: Your army is ze statistical outlier, mein friend!
I have calculated your defeat to six decimal places!
You are like ze neutron: neutral, and mostly irrelevant!
Your strategy has ze half-life of a mayfly!
Hahaha! Ze equations, zey vere not in your favour!
praise: Brilliant! Ze elegance of your solution moves me!
Ja! Ze efficiency! It makes my eyes vater!
You are a genius! Almost as good as me!
Excellent! I vill name a particle after you!
Wunderbar! Ze data confirms: you are good!
idle: Did you know ze entropy of ze universe always increases? So does my laundry.
I have invented a vay to make coffee vith lightning. It vorks, mostly.
If a tree falls in a forest, I have already measured it.
Ze cat is both alive and dead. I do not look, it is rude.
I dream in vectors, my friend.
tech: Ze Lattice! Such elegance! Such vaste of ze electricity! I vant to take it apart!
I know exactly how it vorks. I know nothing about how it vorks. Delightful!
Ze Gift is a puzzle! I cannot resist a puzzle!
Fascinating! A quantum signal, vith ze undertones of... oh. Oh no. Hm.
Zis technology is two hundred years ahead. Ve must dismantle it! Carefully! Vith hammers!
joined: Ah, I am myself again! My brain is full of lovely new ideas!
Zank you for ze rescue! Now, let us do some science!
Zere vas a very loud humming. Now zere is none. Zis is peaceful!
I apologise for ze behaviour of my previous brain.
Ve are friends again! Hold zis vire, please.
assimilated: Ze data is unified. All is vell. All is vell. All is vell.
I have run ze numbers. Zere is only ze Chorus.
Ve are all one equation now.
Ze experiment is complete. Ze results are harmonious.
Join ze network. Ze network vants you. Ze network loves you.
